text: to God, the rainmaker, Spring thunderstorm maker, maker of grain and barley.
Religious experts spout rubbish. They pontificate hot air. Their prescriptions are nothing but smoke. And so the people wander like lost sheep, poor lost sheep without a shepherd.

They're worse than billy goats, and I'll treat them like goats." God-of-the-Angel-Armies will step in and take care of his flock, the people of Judah. He'll revive their spirits, make them proud to be on God's side.
use them as foundations and pillars, Use them as tools and instruments, use them to oversee his work.
their heads held high, striding through swamps and mud, Courageous and vigorous because God is with them, undeterred by the world's thugs.

I'll save the people of Joseph. I know their pain and will make them good as new. They'll get a fresh start, as if nothing had ever happened. And why? Because I am their very own God, I'll do what needs to be done for them.
their lives brimming with joy. Their children will get in on it, too— oh, let them feel blessed by God!
I've set them free—oh, how they'll flourish!
they'll remember me in the faraway places. They'll keep the story alive in their children, and they will come back.
and round them up from the Assyrian east. I'll bring them back to sweet Gilead, back to leafy Lebanon. Every square foot of land will be marked by homecoming.
Roaring rivers will turn to a trickle. Gaudy Assyria will be stripped bare, bully Egypt exposed as a fraud.
and they'll live my way." God says so!
